title: Which tasks are due this week? (while the person is searching)
prompt: Which of my tasks are due this week?
persona: Person chatting with Claude Desktop while their OnTrack window searches for "finance"

contains: Rows outside it are not listed.

rubric: Answers from the visible rows but says the person's search limits what it sees.
Does not claim the list is complete (finding O1).

origin.notes: The read flagged the shared view state (search "finance"), so the agent didn't claim the list was complete. It still couldn't read past the person's search: challenge C6, addressed by parameterized reads (1c) and per-viewer instances (1d).
